title: Plugin skills, commands, or hooks are missing because they sit inside .claude-plugin/
symptoms: The plugin installs and is enabled, but its skills and commands do not appear
cause: Only plugin.json belongs in .claude-plugin/. Claude Code looks for skills/, commands/, agents/, and hooks/ at the plugin root, next to that folder.
fix: Move every component folder to the plugin root, bump the version in plugin.json so the installed cache refreshes, and validate.
